newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran planning to make laser-guided bombs, plane.
newsitem.headline: Iran planning to make laser-guided bombs, plane.

text.p: Iran announced on Monday plans to build a training aircraft and laser-guided bombs as part of efforts to become self-sufficient in military production, the Iranian news agency IRNA said.
It quoted air force commander Brigadier-General Habib Baqaei as saying the training plane, designed in Iran and modelled after various foreign aircraft, would be tested in February.
Baqaei also said the high-precision bombs, built by air force "self-sufficiency jihad units", had been successfully tested and mass production would start soon.
The units were set up during the 1980-88 Iran-Iraq war to manufacture components that could not be easily obtained due to a Western arms embargo and to design and build new weapons.

The daily Ettelaat newspaper quoted deputy navy commander Rear Admiral Mohammad Hossein Shafiei as saying construction would begin soon on a locally-designed destroyer which would be 88 metres (yards) long and cruise at a top speed of 30 knots.
Iran says it has become largely self-sufficient in weapons production and is supplying arms to other states, although Tehran has relied on Russia for some aircraft and submarines.
Iran said on Sunday it would take delivery of its third Russian-made diesel submarine within six months.
